capabilities: Record items with price, purchase date and cover image
Link accessories to a main item
Compute net cost and daily cost
Archive sold or retired items by dragging cards
Export an item or the whole ledger as a share image
disambiguation: Not a bookkeeping or bank-account ledger; it tracks physical belongings and their cost per day of use.
extras: Interface is mainly Simplified Chinese; amounts are shown in CNY with no currency conversion; the optional Mac cutout component must be installed manually and only runs on macOS 14+ desktop.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep track of what you own, what it cost, and how much it costs per day of use.
summary: Local item ledger that records belongings, accessories, purchase and sale prices, and computes net cost and daily cost of ownership.
